trustControls: export: export study history to CSV
revoke: disconnect course import or third-party sync
delete: remove a session log or journal entry
notes: Honesty triples (Data Honesty section): Study sessions — real = logged minutes/pages + 'you logged'; low-confidence = imported partial session + 'estimated · low confidence'; honest-null = no session prompt, 'Add your first book or course to start tracking.' Course/book progress — real = user/provider progress; low-confidence = stale import; honest-null = empty library. Skill mastery — real = enough sessions/goals; low-confidence = inferred label; honest-null = 'complete a few sessions to map skills.' CIA suggestions — real = current learning plan; low-confidence = draft suggestion; honest-null = hidden until context exists. States: Skeleton — hero ring, KPI row, bars, chart axis, and library rows shimmer in place. Empty — welcome note, ghosted progress ring, add book/course CTA, no fake study data. Error — failed import names the provider and keeps manual logs. Success — logged session updates progress/streak/study time with a green confirmation. Disabled — imports, projections, or journal handoff dim when consent/connectivity block them. Motion: hero ring fills, KPIs count, bars rise, chart draws actual then projection on load; FAB opens a Sheet for reading/lesson/course/reflection; suggestion rows animate to green and can undo; chart scrub shows date, minutes, source, confidence; the reflect chip opens Journal [37] with the prompt prefilled; reduced-motion renders all charts/count-ups at final state. Never SIA, always CIA. Sentence case, no exclamation marks. Nav pill 'Today · CIA · Goals · Me' floats fixed near y756-824, overlaying scrollable content; FABQuickLog sits fixed just above it. Accessibility: charts summarize value/source/confidence before points; rows, FAB, chart points, suggestions, and tabs are 44px minimum; paper text on #0A0A0F/#211008 meets AA+.
